meta.note: Curated public-source directory for research and verification. 'VERIFIED SOURCE' means the link and source identity were checked; it does not mean every claim found there is automatically true. Derived findings and unresolved leads remain separately labeled.

resources.title: Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC)
resources.description: Official geographic classification for regions, provinces, cities, municipalities and barangays, with versioned releases and API documentation.
resources.why: Use PSGC codes as stable geographic keys before attaching BantayLink records to places.

resources.organization: Department of Public Works and Highways
resources.title: DPWH Transparency Portal
resources.description: Public portal for DPWH contracts with search by contract name, location or contractor, plus cost, accomplishment and completion information.
resources.why: Primary place to cross-check project identity, contractor, cost and reported accomplishment.

resources.organization: eFOI / Department of Public Works and Highways
resources.title: DPWH eFOI records
resources.description: Publicly viewable Freedom of Information request threads and agency responses.
resources.why: Useful for primary-source clarifications that may resolve conflicting project-status or document questions.
links: Example: Status of listed DPWH Project

resources.title: COA Audit Reports
resources.description: Official audit-report material covering annual, consolidated, management, financial, compliance and performance audit work.
resources.why: Use audit reports to verify findings, recommendations and government-accountability records rather than treating an analytical flag as an audit conclusion.

resources.title: GPPB issuances and resolutions
resources.description: Official procurement policy, resolutions, circulars and guidance under the New Government Procurement Act.
resources.why: Provides the policy basis needed to interpret procurement records correctly.

resources.title: PhilGEPS procurement notices
resources.description: Official procurement-service pages containing Notices of Award, Notices to Proceed and related procurement documents.
resources.why: Cross-check award and proceeding stages when a contractor or procurement relationship appears in BantayLink.

resources.title: SIDLAN infrastructure API
resources.description: DA SIDLAN provides API access to I-BUILD infrastructure subproject datasets, including project identifiers, locations, costs, stage and progress fields.
resources.why: Machine-readable source for DA infrastructure records and geographic project joins.

resources.title: COMELEC election records and transparency materials
resources.description: Official COMELEC issuances and election-data documentation used to anchor election-related research.
resources.why: Primary source for election rules, official election materials and election-data provenance.
links: Example: Resolution 11087 on access to election-results data

resources.title: FOI policies and Executive Order No. 2
resources.description: Official policy resources covering the Executive Branch Freedom of Information framework and exceptions.
resources.why: Helps researchers understand what an FOI record is, how it was requested, and the limits on interpreting it.

resources.title: OpenHalalan election datasets
resources.description: Independent, reproducible Philippine election-result datasets with documented provenance, coverage notes and known gaps.
resources.why: Useful for research and discovery, but individual records should be checked against the underlying official COMELEC material before being treated as settled fact.
